predictions.label: V
predictions.reason: Producer acquires tool before source pickup and releases it in finally (LONG satisfied), but produce(0) signals ready_0 before empty_0 is signaled/cleared, and the i==1 branch waits/clears empty_0 only inside produce(1); with producer/consumer gathered, produce(0) can publish ready_0 and proceed to produce(1) before consume(0) signals empty_0, so the required producer-waits-empty_0-before-second-buffer ordering is not guaranteed. Also buffer_0/buffer_1 share one capacity and both lock during entry/departure, but the ordering gap can cause concurrent buffer access.
